about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Professional Profile - There Is All About Me
about.bio_paragraph_1: I have been studying programming for 3 years, specializing as a Front-end Developer focused on creating modern, responsive, and intuitive web interfaces. I am passionate about bringing designs to life through clean and efficient code.
about.bio_paragraph_2: Currently based in Japan, I am studying Business and IT. This combination allows me to unite technical front-end development with a strategic business mindset, building digital products that deliver real value to users and organizations.

services.section_subtitle: What I Can Do For You

web_dev.title: Web Development
web_dev.desc: Building modern, fast, and scalable websites and web applications using React and Tailwind CSS.

ui_ux.title: UI/UX Design
ui_ux.desc: Crafting clean, intuitive, and user-centered interfaces with Figma for seamless digital experiences.

responsive.title: Responsive Design
responsive.desc: Ensuring your website looks and works flawlessly across all devices, from mobile to desktop.

performance.title: Performance & SEO
performance.desc: Optimizing page load speed and structuring clean code for improved search engine rankings.

api.title: API Integration
api.desc: Connecting front-end applications with RESTful APIs, databases, and dynamic external services.

branding.title: Brand Identity
branding.desc: Creating impactful visual elements, color schemes, and styles to strengthen your brand presence.

brastel.title: Brastel Conceptual Redesign
brastel.overview: A conceptual redesign project for the Brastel website interface. The goal was to create a more modern, intuitive, and visually appealing experience using Figma, reorganizing information architecture and visual hierarchy while preserving the brand's core identity.
brastel.feature1: Modern UI/UX designed from scratch in Figma, following contemporary visual best practices.
brastel.feature2: High-fidelity interactive prototyping simulating real user navigation flows for mobile and desktop.
brastel.feature3: Design system and style guide including updated color palettes, typography, and reusable components.

challenge1.title: Modernization Without Losing Brand Identity
challenge1.desc: The original website was cluttered and visually outdated, requiring content reorganization to maintain clarity for multilingual users.
challenge1.sol: Structured a clean layout with optimized contrast, simplified menus, and responsive components built in Figma.

pokemon.title: Pokedex Web App
pokemon.overview: An interactive web application built to explore Pokémon data in real time using the PokéAPI, focusing on user experience and fast response times.
pokemon.feature1: Asynchronous PokéAPI fetching for dynamic search and detailed stats view.
pokemon.feature2: Responsive UI built with React and styled using Tailwind CSS.
pokemon.feature3: Type filtering and pagination system to optimize image loading.

challenge1.title: Optimizing API Requests and Image Loading
challenge1.desc: The large volume of data and API requests caused slow initial rendering times.
challenge1.sol: Implemented lazy loading for images and efficient request pagination.

app.title: Kakeibo — Personal Finance App
app.overview: Kakeibo is a personal finance mobile app inspired by the Japanese concept of kakeibo. The project was designed to help young adults track their spending, manage their budget, and set financial goals through a simple, visual, and intuitive experience.
app.feature1: A visual dashboard with balance, recent transactions, and an overview of spending habits.
app.feature2: Quick flows for recording expenses, making transfers, and managing the monthly budget.
app.feature3: Goal tracking and visual analytics that help users understand their spending and stay on track with their financial goals.

challenge1.title: Making Personal Finance Simple and Intuitive
challenge1.desc: Financial apps can present a large amount of information at once, making it difficult for users to quickly understand their financial situation.
challenge1.sol: A clean and visual interface was created using clear information hierarchy, consistent components, and simple charts to turn financial data into easy-to-understand insights.

quiz.title: Programming Quiz
quiz.overview: An interactive quiz game designed to test knowledge in web development and programming concepts.
quiz.feature1: Complex state management in React for scoring and timer tracking.
quiz.feature2: Dynamic UI with instant visual feedback for correct and incorrect answers.
quiz.feature3: Final summary screen displaying overall performance and question reviews.

challenge1.title: Timer State Control and Screen Transitions
challenge1.desc: Synchronizing question timers with automatic screen transitions without causing unnecessary re-renders.
challenge1.sol: Optimized usage of useEffect and useRef hooks to manage timer lifecycle smoothly.

one-piece.title: McDonald's x One Piece Campaign
one-piece.overview: Academic marketing project proposing a collaboration campaign between McDonald's and the anime One Piece to launch a limited-edition meal combo.
one-piece.feature1: Marketing strategy conceptualization and target audience definition.
one-piece.feature2: Promotional banners and social media assets designed in Canva.
one-piece.feature3: Brand identity blend combining McDonald's corporate look with One Piece elements.

challenge1.title: Merging Two Iconic Brand Identities
challenge1.desc: Preserving McDonald's brand recognition while integrating the distinct aesthetic of One Piece.
challenge1.sol: Balanced McDonald's core red-and-yellow colors with key character illustrations and anime typography.

github.title: GitHub Profile Searcher
github.overview: A web application designed to fetch real-time data from the official GitHub REST API. Users can search for any profile, view detailed statistics, and explore public repositories.
github.feature1: Full integration with GitHub REST API using Axios/Fetch.
github.feature2: Detailed profile breakdown (followers, repositories, stars, and bio).
github.feature3: Fast search interface with user-friendly error handling for missing profiles.

challenge1.title: Handling API Rate Limits and Error States
challenge1.desc: Managing invalid user inputs and public API rate limitations gracefully.
challenge1.sol: Created visual error state components and handled response status codes (e.g., 404) properly.
